%% Template file: do not edit it in a module (see "Template and module files" in README.md).
%% Header of every PDF sheet (replaces Quarto's default \maketitle).
%% Variables are set by template.lua from _module.yml.
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\fancyhead[L]{\small $module$ -- $header-title$}
\fancyhead[R]{\small $term$}
\fancyfoot[C]{\small Page \thepage\ of \pageref*{LastPage}}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
\fancypagestyle{plain}{}  % same style on the first page

{\raggedright
{\color{accent}\LARGE\bfseries $title$\par}
$if(banner)$
\vspace{4pt}
$if(banner-alert)$
{\color{alert}\small\bfseries $banner$\par}
$else$
{\color{accent}\small\bfseries $banner$\par}
$endif$
$endif$
}
\vspace{10pt}
